## PREAMBLE

This collective bargaining agreement entered into this  $ 16^{th} $ day of November, 1999 by the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, acting through the Secretary for Administration and his/her Human Resource Division, hereinafter referred to as the "EMPLOYER", or the Commonwealth; and by the Massachusetts Organization of State Engineers and Scientists, hereinafter referred to as "MOSES", and has as its purpose the promotion of harmonious relations between MOSES and the Employer.
